comment: qa-screenshots/<name>.png → its committed baseline in screenshots/baselines/. The gate is a regression check against Native's own shipped design. The ref-*.png Modrinth captures in screenshots/ remain the historical design source (design-system.md) but are no longer scored against: the launcher-remake rebrand (navy mono identity, blue accent) diverges from their palette by design. To re-baseline after an intentional visual change: run the visual-qa capture, review every changed screen by eye, then copy qa-screenshots/<name>.png over screenshots/baselines/<name>.png.
